464814.overview:
Goodbye Universe is a narrative adventure game. It builds upon the emotional storytelling and experimental control schemes of Before Your Eyes, a title most developers were previously involved with, using first-person interaction to explore memory, time, and family relationships. Players inhabit the perspective of Isaac, a six-month-old baby who possesses telekinetic and telepathic abilities. The game’s story unfolds through his eyes and memories, blending everyday domestic life with supernatural elements.

The narrative centers on Isaac's family that consists of his parents, sister, and grandfather, and their complex emotional lives. As Isaac grows, he perceives their thoughts and feelings through his powers, offering insight into their struggles and hopes. The story is narrated by an adult Isaac reflecting on his childhood, while players relive key moments from infancy onward.

Gameplay revolves around simple physical and emotional interactions. Using regular controls or camera tracking through a webcam (Windows and Switch 2 only), players can manipulate the environment with actions such as closing cabinets, turning on lights, or cleaning up toys, but also by blinking, gesturing, closing eyes to rearrange scenes, frowning, or focusing their gaze. Isaac's telepathic ability allows players to "listen" to the thoughts of others, often portrayed as layered audio collages that convey character moods and inner conflicts. This can also be done by closing you eyes and tilting your head to tune in to a signal.

While most of the game is slow-paced and contemplative, certain moments incorporate more traditional gameplay sequences such as timed gestures or reflex-based telekinetic actions.

467587.overview:
For the first time in the series, you can now explore the asphalt roads of Japan as well as the French Mediterranean coast. 

Drive over 40 prestigious cars from the biggest automotive brands and customize every detail: paint, bodywork, rims, mechanical performance… 

Create a car that reflects your individuality and show off your style on a wide range of spectacular race tracks.

Features
Head to Japan in story mode
After exploring France and Italy, the series takes you to the Land of the Rising Sun. It's up to you to create and grow Gear.Club in Japan: Immerse yourself in the local car culture, challenge your rivals and extend the influence of your club on a new continent. Every win and every choice you make will leave its mark on your journey.

Dodge traffic on the highway
As well as intense races and thrilling Time Attacks, Gear.Club Unlimited 3 adds an innovative new mode on highways. Fight through traffic in France and Japan, and prove that you can master speed and handling at the same time. Anticipate car trajectories, change lanes at the right time, narrowly miss your opponents while overtaking, and take risks to cross the finish line first!

40 iconic cars
An incredible garage awaits with over 40 models from the biggest European and Japanese manufacturers. Experience the Italian spirit of Alfa Romeo and Pagani, the cutting-edge engineering of BMW, Bugatti and Porsche, not to mention legendary Japanese sports cars from Nissan, Subaru, Mazda and Honda.

Dream cars
40 dream cars from top manufacturers.

Tracks
50 tracks to dominate in France and Japan.

Race
NEW: races on French and Japanese highways.

Story mode
An immersive Story mode based on Japanese car culture.

Customization
Extensive customization: mechanical and bodywork. Customize your garage.
